findings.title: Checkpoint selection RNG restoration is overwritten by inherited startup reseeding.
findings.trigger: Resume a committed synchronous FedDyn round with server.random_seed configured, through the actual example Server.run entrypoint.

source_locations.meaning: run restores the checkpoint before starting clients
run reseeds random and replaces self.prng_state after restoration
equivalent reseed exists in the central-server branch; cross-silo remains unsupported
selection overwrites context prng_state from self.prng_state
selection consumes the replaced context state

findings.evidence: Independently executed actual base.Server.run with a scratch-only subclass and the actual RandomSelectionStrategy, Python 3.13.16 and 3.14.8. Seed 17, population 10, per_round 2: committed selections [9,7] then [5,6]; restoring that boundary should select [5,3] next. Startup instead selects [9,7] and the restored state no longer matches. Both probe processes exit 0 after asserting this defect.
findings.impact: The saved cloud/history bundle can be internally coherent yet advertised deterministic continuation fails at the actual user entrypoint. Testing _resume_from_checkpoint and then selecting directly would miss this ordering.
findings.minimal_correction: Add an explicit example-local startup handoff, for example retain validated restored RNG state in _resume_from_checkpoint and reapply it from the FedDyn Server.start override after inherited seeding and before registration/selection. Restore the appropriate live/context selection state and declared CPU RNG states coherently. Keep plato/servers/base.py unchanged and preserve fresh-run seeding. A scratch-only start override already selects the expected [5,3] under the unchanged base run.
findings.acceptance: Extend FD-A12 with actual Server.run/--resume ordering and nontrivial server.random_seed. Verify uninterrupted versus resumed selections and model/all-client histories over a later round, fresh-run seed behavior, and no live RNG/pending resume state change on rejected bundle loads. FD-A13 should include or share this bounded actual-entrypoint resume case.
findings.scope: This requests one example-local hook and a focused continuation case, not generic checkpoint/runtime redesign or mid-round/GPU replay.
findings.ownership: Root alone assigns this correction to the original Astra design author, then obtains a fresh independent review of the revised artifact. No correction was applied by this reviewer.

low_findings.title: FD-A08 names per-update scheduler notifications despite the no-scheduler contract.
low_findings.observation: The accepted normal/tail paths notify optimizer_strategy.on_optimizer_step, model_update_strategy.after_step and on_train_step_end per actual update. lr_scheduler_strategy.step is an epoch-boundary call; no actual scheduler is created in the supported example. FD-A08 says exactly two optimizer/scheduler/after-step notifications.
low_findings.minimal_correction: Name the two actual optimizer/update/callback notifications and assert no scheduler creation or actual scheduler stepping. If spying on the no-op epoch scheduler strategy, distinguish its epoch call count from optimizer update count. Do not add or alter generic scheduler behavior.
low_findings.acceptance: The three-microbatch/two-update scalar remains y=1.99005, h_next=.49005; its update counts remain two and zero-completed attempts still fail.

source_reconciliation.conclusion: Its linear term contributes alpha_i*(-x+h); SGD decay alpha_i+weight_decay contributes alpha_i*w when external weight_decay0. Together this is alpha_i*(w-x+h). The shifted quadratic plus linear h is therefore correct; an additional -x linear term doubles the shift.
source_reconciliation.execution: Executed the exact pinned function body for a float64 zero-task-gradient scalar, returning2.0. Separately executed split-decay clipping order: inactive case agrees; active scalar derivative20 produces author split y=.980000050505048 versus explicit unclipped y0. The design correctly rejects clipping and limits equivalence claims.

source_reconciliation.conclusion: Counts normalize to population-mean-one q; effective alpha is alpha/q. History adds endpoint minus cloud without q scaling. Cloud uses uniform selected endpoint mean plus all-population history mean, in both modes. Selected/all/cloud evaluation models differ.
source_reconciliation.execution: Executed pinned normalization, alpha, history and cloud statements for counts1/3; obtained q=.5/1.5, alpha1=.2 and cloud1.436. Full three-round expectations derive independently from Fraction affine updates and paper signed gradient states.

source_reconciliation.conclusion: Let paper client gradient state be g_i=-alpha*h_i for common-alpha scaled losses. Its server average is -alpha*mean(h). The paper subtracts that state divided by alpha, yielding selected mean(y)+population mean(h). Scaling local task losses by q_i explains sample weighting; finite-step SGD is an inexact solve and does not establish a new convergence theorem.

algorithm_assessment.history_and_cloud: h_i_next=h_i+y_i-x exactly once for successful selected clients; other histories unchanged. x_next=uniform mean_selected(y)+uniform mean_population(h_next).
algorithm_assessment.weighting: Uniform default q_i1; sample q_i=N*n_i/sum(n), alpha_i=alpha/q_i. Positive fixed realized counts and complete population vector in sample mode. Labels never enter alpha.
algorithm_assessment.qualification: Plain CPU float32/float64 SGD, zero momentum/decay, no scheduler/clipping/AMP/DP, fixed nonempty trainables and static frozen/buffer state. Explicit full-loss differentiation avoids double alpha decay. Strict actual optimizer ownership and original-model validation are necessary.

feasibility_assessment.client: The proposed DefaultTrainingStrategy subclass must be installed via _configure_composable: DefaultPayloadStrategy directly calls load_payload/train (defaults.py:297). simple.Client._load_payload/_train overrides alone are bypassed. Successful-result checks and stale training_error clearing can stop the generic ValueError/report fallback before outbound send.
feasibility_assessment.server: fedavg._process_reports retains subclass aggregate_weights when _should_prefer_weight_aggregation returns false (fedavg.py:202-228). weights_received and post-callback aggregate validation can reject original model/metadata batches. weights_aggregated follows live model load, so example-local wrapper snapshots must contain all precommit exceptions and direct tensor restoration must not re-enter the injected failing loader.
feasibility_assessment.worker: Composable requires_worker_state/get_worker_state/load_worker_state supports actual spawn. Generic load_model precedes load_worker_state (composable.py:855-858); example-local Trainer.train can snapshot/rollback actual model and owned strategy/context. Child stages history only, carries dispatch and baseline, and parent verifies h_next against the accepted loaded endpoint before publishing. Zero-step failure and normal/tail after_step hooks are available. No canonical child history write may survive a rejected result.
feasibility_assessment.metadata: Realized loader sampler cardinality is available only after create_train_loader. The new local wrapper can bind it before optimizer construction/first compute_loss and report the same worker-accepted count, avoiding later generic sampler redraw/backing-dataset fallbacks. It must store a dedicated authoritative count rather than trust generic context.num_samples overwritten afterward.
feasibility_assessment.startup: All selected adapter mechanisms exist in the immutable snapshot. The sole identified design gap is inherited run reseeding after checkpoint restore; local start interception is available and independently demonstrated.
feasibility_assessment.failure_round: current_round increments on dispatch (base.py:568), so committed_round and committed RNG snapshot must remain distinct. Keep the fixed selected set through max_concurrency batches and commit only when every member validates. Default disconnect recovery under general.debug=false (base.py:1522) must be disabled/rejected or intercepted locally to enforce the already stated no-dropout/retry contract; this is an implementation caution under the explicit unsupported-mode requirement, not a separate design blocker.
feasibility_assessment.user_invocation: Existing example path/config and algorithm.type=fedavg can remain. Dedicated adapters come from main. Existing LeNet has no mutable registered buffers; shipped counts600, SGD lr.03/momentum0/decay0 satisfy the bounded CPU command. New uniform default avoids fabricating a1000-entry count vector. Actual three-round/socket/spawn entrypoint qualification remains required.

proportionality_and_migration.history_placement: Central population histories are not the only possible mathematical placement, but are a bounded, coherent choice for logical-client reuse, current-worker pairing and whole-round rejection in the retained composable example. Sparse omitted never-selected zeros limit state in short default runs. Extra history downlink/O(Nd) server storage must be disclosed; no original communication-budget claim.
proportionality_and_migration.checkpoint_minimum: After server-owned histories are selected, model-only or separate unsynchronized client history checkpoints cannot preserve retained continuation. One atomic versioned model/population-history/schema/count/alpha/committed-round/selection-RNG bundle is the minimum coherent authority for this choice. Fresh local momentum-free SGD needs no retained optimizer state. Mid-round recovery, arbitrary datasource RNG and exact GPU replay remain outside scope.
proportionality_and_migration.intentional_api_change: The public class exports remain; corrected training requires explicit validated server-provided dispatch state. This is a deliberate numerical/state-interface migration, not transparent backward compatibility. Explicit read_legacy_history remains meaningful for save_path and returns detached validated historical data without adoption or writes; unsupported old training receives migration guidance.

The separate required operation and strong FD-A15 old-writer fixture make this clear, bounded and testable rather than contradictory.
